note: Submodule of element_class_formatter. Adds one field formatter, responsive_image_class ('Responsive image (with class)'), for image fields: it extends core ResponsiveImageFormatter and mixes in ElementEntityClassTrait to add an 'Element class' setting applied to the image element (#item_attributes). Requires element_class_formatter + core responsive_image. No settings page, no configure route, no permissions, no Drush. Settings stored in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.type = responsive_image_class + settings.class; schema field.formatter.settings.responsive_image_class. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that display config: introspection reads the configured formatter/class on an image field; execution switches an image field to responsive_image_class with a given class, verified against the live entity_view_display.

evals.prompt: How do I add a CSS class to a Responsive Image field's element in Drupal, and what is the formatter id provided by element_class_formatter_responsive_image?
evals.expected_output: Use the 'Responsive image (with class)' formatter (id responsive_image_class) on the image field's Manage display row; it works like the core Responsive Image formatter plus an 'Element class' field applied to the image element.

evals.prompt: Which field type does the responsive_image_class formatter apply to, and what modules does it require?
evals.expected_output: It applies to image fields and requires element_class_formatter plus core's responsive_image module. It extends core's ResponsiveImageFormatter.

evals.prompt: Where is the class set on a responsive image (via element_class_formatter_responsive_image) stored in configuration?
evals.expected_output: In the field's component of core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode>: type = responsive_image_class and settings.class = the space-separated classes (schema field.formatter.settings.responsive_image_class).

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has an image field (field_ecfri_img) shown as a responsive image with element_class_formatter_responsive_image. Inspect the live default display and state the CSS class applied to the image element.
evals.expected_output: field_ecfri_img uses the responsive_image_class formatter with settings.class = 'rounded' in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: The Article image field field_ecfri_img is displayed with a class-adding responsive image formatter. Inspect the live display and state the formatter id (type) it uses.
evals.expected_output: field_ecfri_img's component type is responsive_image_class (with settings.class = rounded).

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has an image field field_ecfri_pic shown with the plain core image formatter. Using element_class_formatter_responsive_image, change its default display so the responsive image element gets the CSS class 'hero-img'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ecfri_pic component uses type responsive_image_class with settings.class containing 'hero-img'.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has an image field field_ecfri_ph displayed with the plain core image formatter. Using element_class_formatter_responsive_image, display it as a responsive image whose element carries the CSS class 'img-fluid'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ecfri_ph component uses type responsive_image_class with settings.class containing 'img-fluid'.
